title: Add Cookie Banner
content: Create GDPR-compliant cookie consent banner. Position: fixed bottom-0 full-width or floating card in corner. Content: brief explanation of cookie usage, link to Privacy Policy. Buttons: "Accept All", "Reject All" or "Necessary Only", "Manage Preferences" link. Preferences modal: categorized toggles (Necessary - always on, Functional, Analytics, Marketing). Save preferences to localStorage with consent timestamp. Hide banner once user makes choice. Re-show option in footer settings link. Styling: subtle shadow, z-50, doesn't block main content. Animation: slide up from bottom. Add optional detailed cookie list in preferences. Remember to not set non-essential cookies before consent. Show again after policy update with new timestamp check.

variants.advanced: Create GDPR-compliant cookie consent banner with preferences management. Banner component: fixed bottom-0 inset-x-0 z-50 (full-width) or fixed bottom-4 right-4 max-w-md (floating card). Animation: slide up from bottom (translate-y-full to translate-y-0) with fade. Banner content: bg-white shadow-lg rounded-t-xl (full) or rounded-xl (card), p-4. Text: brief explanation "We use cookies to improve your experience", link to Privacy Policy (text-blue-600 hover:underline). Buttons: flex gap-3 mt-4, "Accept All" (primary bg-blue-600), "Reject All" or "Necessary Only" (secondary outline), "Manage Preferences" (text link). Preferences modal: triggered by link, categorized cookie toggles. Categories: Necessary (always on, toggle disabled, required for site function), Functional (remember preferences), Analytics (usage data), Marketing (ads, tracking). Each category: toggle switch, name, description of what cookies do. Cookie list option: expandable list showing individual cookies with name, provider, purpose, expiration. Consent storage: localStorage object with {necessary: true, functional: boolean, analytics: boolean, marketing: boolean, timestamp: ISO date, version: "1.0"}. Implementation: check localStorage on mount, if no consent or outdated version show banner. Save preferences: update localStorage, trigger callback to enable/disable scripts. Script control: don't load analytics/marketing scripts until consent given, load conditionally based on preferences. Re-consent: show banner again if policy version changes (timestamp check). Footer link: "Cookie Settings" in footer to re-open preferences modal. ACCESSIBILITY: proper focus management in modal, form labels for toggles, banner not blocking content navigation. Legal compliance: log consent with timestamp, allow withdrawal, don't pre-check non-essential categories. Component API: policyVersion, privacyPolicyUrl, onConsent callback with preferences object.
